scope: Independent read-only standard-library recomputation; no project analysis imports or new robot trials.
checks: Transitive source and evidence SHA bindings; 120 sidecars and compressed traces.
Body-origin target, wrapped angle, whole-attempt peaks including initial state and strict >95% termination.
Last48 actual movements include the pre-window state; command/pusher/block motion and query counts.
Chronological maximum drawdown with first subsequent regained peak.
Block-only terminal stationarity and nonterminal >=24-movement near-target stationary runs.
Saved finite camera rows, peak estimate, false-completion counts and maximum errors.
All suffix windows including hash-bound reuse of old diagnoses; post-interruption executed prefixes.
All40 initial/common prefixes, outcome-group inventories, medians and diagnostic bins.
limits: No physical replay, RGB re-estimation, model inference or reconstruction of full latent RNG/observation state.
Saved true pose, future drawdown and stationary-window boundaries are offline outcomes, not deployable runtime inputs.
A common initial prefix does not establish matched later states or causal recovery from a controller change.
One stochastic policy sample per method/scene and outcome-defined inspected scenes cannot establish a reliable failure classifier.
Body-origin coordinates are simulator/action units, not physical metres or camera pixels; static goal inspected without importing simulator.

1e-12 arithmetic comparison tolerance applies only to audit scalar recomputation; recorded action/state/pixel fields require exact equality in common prefixes except established true-coverage tolerance.
